messages:
rachel: quick flag thought. telemetry shows v1 degradation on long-context batches. instead of hiding v1 outright, what about a Console 'soft-offer' pattern: keep v1 visible but mark as 'legacy' and surface a compatibility widget + migration estimate when creating new routes. would reduce surprise.

omar: i like 'soft-offer' better from a UX POV. ops request: if we run compatibility probes, they must not bill tenants or they will call in. Can we send mirrored probes into a billing-sandbox probe bucket and surface internal probe_volume for autoscaling?

sasha: agree. also add a small per-route projected-cost-delta chart (tokens x price) so customers see spend impact before switching. that should lower CS tickets.

rachel: implementation sketch:
- Console label: "v1 (legacy)" in create-route, with checkbox "Show migration estimator" that opens the compatibility widget
- widget does sampled mirror probes (default 0.5%) to v2, records fail/latency/quality delta, shows seq-len histogram + projected token delta + cost delta
- mirror probes tagged as probe=true routed to probe_bucket (non-billable) but emit internal metric probe_volume for sizing
- bulk unpin / migrate remains opt-in and is behind an explicit confirmation modal

ty: two operational asks: 1) probe traffic must be capped per-tenant to avoid any accidental capacity storms; 2) we need a rollout policy that schedules tenants into cohorts so v2 autoscaling can warm up.

omar: add to that: we should estimate the delta in v2 GPU-seconds and show a capacity-reserve suggestion if projected shift > 5% tenant traffic and cluster >65% usage. also suggest a soft reservation purchase option in Console.

sasha: alerting thresholds proposal: if probe fail-rate delta > 4% OR generation-quality metric (nll/perplexity) drifts > 8%, mark widget status 'incompatible' and surface an ops runbook link + disable auto-migrate.

rachel: runbook rough steps: set feature.console.soft_offer.probe_rate=0, disable probe_bucket flag, notify affected tenants, rollback any staged migrations, clear probe tags from billing aggregation. I'll add explicit step to remove probe metrics from customer-facing billing windows.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag feature.console.soft_offer staged -> targeting canary & staging-1

ty: from a telemetry perspective, please add a per-tenant field: projected_token_delta_percent and projected_cost_delta_usd so CS dashboards can filter risky tenants.

omar: implement flags: feature.console.soft_offer.enabled (bool), feature.console.soft_offer.probe_rate (float), feature.console.soft_offer.probe_bucket (bool), feature.console.soft_offer.bulk_migrate_optin (bool), feature.console.soft_offer.per_tenant_cap (int). include default probe_rate=0.005.

sasha: UI copy draft: "v1 (legacy) — view compatibility estimator" tooltip: "Run sampled compatibility probes to estimate latency, error, and cost deltas. Probes are routed to an internal non-billable bucket; we emit internal capacity metrics for planning."

rachel: i'll open a tiny PR with wireframes and the backend flag contract and tag @omar @sasha @ty. planning to include a short canary cohort list and a CS-facing widget mock.

sasha: thanks. also please add a telemetry widget that exposes both absolute and percent token deltas per-route over last 7 days. helps us catch weird seasonal spikes.

rachel: will add. PR incoming.
